summary.name: Virbo
summary.one_liner: Virbo (Wondershare) is an AI video generator that creates product videos with digital human presenters from a sentence, product image, or link.
use_cases: Creating product review or unboxing videos without filming
Testing different presenters and scenes for a product
Turning live-stream talking points into video drafts
Generating product videos from a product photo or link
Producing commerce videos for multiple seller accounts
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Virbo as an AI video generator for commerce content. Users start from a sentence, a product image, or a product link, and the tool generates a product video with a chosen person and scene. A template library covers 18 categories such as fashion, beauty, personal care, and food, with formats like reviews, unboxings, TVCs, and comparisons. The page says its "Hybrid Control" technology blends AI generation with live footage and aims to preserve the creator's identity and product details. Listing text on the referring page adds that it supports digital human customization for personal IP. The page also states 350+ avatars, 400 voices, and 80 languages in the meta description.
notable: Hybrid Control technology blending AI generation with live footage
Starts from a sentence, product image, or product link
caveats: Complex actions still need careful review, per user testimonials on the page
Pricing tiers are not stated on the page; freemium is from the listing
